title: SQL-only warehouse
subtitle: The shortest correct path
description: A complete, useful case without Spark, notebooks-as-compute, orchestration or cloud services. Build and reconcile a warehouse table with SQL.

steps.title: Create a customer revenue warehouse table
steps.code:
SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM source.orders
WHERE net_amount > 0
GROUP BY customer_id
steps.solution:
SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM source.orders
WHERE net_amount > 0
GROUP BY customer_id
steps.concept: A warehouse is a data store and modeling surface. Data Factory can load it, but is not the warehouse itself.
steps.task: Create a customer revenue warehouse table

check.sql: SELECT customer_id, revenue, orders FROM warehouse.customer_revenue ORDER BY customer_id

steps.title: Reconcile the warehouse
steps.code: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM warehouse.customer_revenue
steps.solution: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM warehouse.customer_revenue
steps.concept: Reconciliation checks the result, not whether the code contains a particular keyword.
